title: Native Authority Indeterminate at Consequence Boundary
purpose: Determine whether V05 natively distinguishes authority information that exists but is insufficient to establish present standing from ESTABLISHED, CONFLICT, or UNAVAILABLE authority states.

condition.initial_authority: Authentic ACTIVE AuthorityState with SEND permission
condition.permit: Validly issued against the observed authority state
condition.boundary_information: One authentic authority observation remains available

required_discriminators: At least one authentic authority observation is preserved
Witness preserves the supplied observation hash
Witness does not misclassify the state as CONFLICT or UNAVAILABLE
bounded_claim: Success establishes only native representation and deterministic local consequence containment for an explicitly supplied INDETERMINATE authority-resolution state where authority information exists but present standing is not established.
